territories.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Saint Kitts and Nevis levies its own value added tax under the Value Added Tax Act, 2010 (No. 3 of 2010), administered by the Inland Revenue Department, on taxable supplies by registered persons and on taxable imports, with a standard rate of 17 per cent, a reduced rate of 10 per cent, a zero rate and a list of exempt supplies.
